description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl, containing household survey data (food_exp and income).

Perform the following econometric analysis:
1. Estimate three quantile regression models with 'food_exp' as the dependent variable and 'income' as the regressor (plus a constant) for tau = 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75.
2. Save the full model outputs for all three regressions into a single text file at '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/quantreg_results.txt'.
3. Compare the slope coefficients for 'income' across the three quantiles. Create a summary file at '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/quantreg_summary.txt' containing a single line stating which quantile (0.25, 0.50, or 0.75) has the LARGEST estimated income effect.

You can use the Gretl console (e.g., 'quantreg 0.25 food_exp const income') or the GUI (Model > Robust estimation > Quantile regression).
